ui.hub.detail.back_aria.note: Returns to the hub's agent grid. Name that surface with the locale's OWN shipped title (zh-CN 智能体中心, es Hub de agentes, ...); 'Agent Hub' stays Latin only in the locales whose own navigation ships it that way (es/fr/hi/ru/ur/vi). Corrected 2026-10-29: the earlier note told every locale to keep the English title, which contradicted zh-CN's shipped 智能体中心.

ui.hub.detail.created.note: When the listing was published. {ago} is a relative span ('3 days'), {date} the calendar date; both are formatted by the app, not translated.

placeholders.ago: Relative distance from now, already formatted.

ui.hub.detail.created_by_with_email.note: Used only when the hub sent an email beside the name.

placeholders.author: The hub account's display name.
placeholders.email: The address the hub sent, verbatim.

ui.hub.detail.delist_body.note: Says how bad it is: the delisting is immediate, and re-uploading undoes it. Keep the quoted {name} in quotation marks.

placeholders.name: The agent's display name, quoted in the sentence.

ui.hub.detail.delisting.note: Announced while the delist request is in flight.

ui.hub.detail.failure.delist.note: Names the action that failed; the sentence under it carries the reason.

placeholders.ago: Relative distance from now, already formatted.

ui.hub.detail.load_failed_body.note: Prefixed to the transport's own reason. Keep Radient in Latin.

ui.hub.detail.not_found.note: The id loaded but the hub returned no row.

ui.hub.detail.unknown_author.note: The hub sent no author name.

ui.hub.detail.viewer_unknown.note: The viewer's own like/favourite state failed to read; the two controls render unavailable rather than unfilled.
